columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Primary key for this table. System generated.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IRC_CAMPAIGNS_B table.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the type of the asset. Lookup type - ORA_IRC_CAMP_ASSET_TYPE

columns.name: ASSET_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores the status of the asset.

columns.name: PARENT_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Stores the ASSET_ID of the parent asset.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_DATE
columns.description: Stores the scheduled date on which the asset should be processed

columns.name: AUDIENCE_DERIVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the audience is already derived for this asset

columns.name: MESSAGE_DESIGN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key reference to IRC_MSG_DESIGNS_B table. Stores reference to the email design.

columns.name: SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Specifies the targeted site for the Social Media Post

columns.name: START_DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Stores start Delivery date for the asset

columns.name: LAST_DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Stores last Delivery date for the asset

columns.name: FOLLOWUP_DELAY
columns.description: Delay after Sending the Primary Asset in Days

columns.name: ASSET_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Stores the scheduled frequency in Days.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PUBLISH_DEST_CODE
columns.description: Stores the destination of the post. Lookup type - ORA_HCO_CAMP_POST_DESTINATION.
